counterfactual_missing_items: Absence of purulent/pus-like material on curettage
Absence of tenderness on percussion, which would be expected with an abscess
Chronic 2-month dull course rather than an acute abscess presentation
decisive_items: curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue
There was no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
a provisional diagnosis of periapical granuloma
response.rationale: R1 is favored because the gross curettage finding of gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue is characteristic of periapical granuloma, not an abscess. The chronic dull course and lack of percussion tenderness also argue against R2, which relies only on the initial provisional diagnosis and lacks confirmatory suppurative findings.

rejected.why: Supported only by the initial provisional diagnosis; the actual curettage yielded gelatinous/mushy granulation-type tissue rather than pus, and the absence of percussion tenderness and acute course disfavor periapical abscess.
